ablation: Endpoint + User/Sequence + Host-Graph standalone versus calibrated Fusion Meta-Classifier
required_split_policy: group by device_id, user_id, scenario_id or capture_session; keep all related entities wholly within one split

endpoint_autoencoder_iforest.training_source_available: synthetic benign fallback; real OTRF Sysmon attack captures are present
endpoint_autoencoder_iforest.label_scope: No paired benign and Atomic Red Team entity-disjoint evaluation directories are present.
endpoint_autoencoder_iforest.entity_disjoint_evaluation: not run; no labeled benign/attack capture pair to split by capture session

user_sequence_tft.training_source_available: OTRF Sysmon public attack captures; CERT logon cohort not present
user_sequence_tft.label_source: heuristic risk labels from failed logons, host transitions, elevation and command activity
user_sequence_tft.label_scope: Proxy labels are generated from the same input indicators; not verified account-takeover ground truth.
user_sequence_tft.entity_disjoint_evaluation: training code groups by user for its validation split, but this cohort is not aligned to Endpoint, GAT or Fusion test entities

host_graph_gat.label_scope: Network attack-category proxy; not labeled lateral movement ground truth.
host_graph_gat.entity_disjoint_evaluation: existing trainer is transductive on one graph and does not save an entity-disjoint test evaluation

calibrated_fusion_meta_classifier.label_scope: Generated weak incident labels from synthetic branch-score profiles.
calibrated_fusion_meta_classifier.split_scope: Current trainer uses row-level stratified train/validation split, not entity/session-disjoint splits.

entity_disjoint_evaluation: not run because the required shared cohort and independent labels are unavailable
reasons: The three standalone branches use distinct cohorts and targets, so their metrics are not estimates on a common evaluation population.
No shared entity-keyed labeled cohort contains aligned endpoint, user-sequence, and graph inputs with independent incident ground truth.
The available Fusion artifact is trained from synthetic weak-label profiles (or an absent optional CSV) and has no matching branch test rows.
Consequently, fusion-versus-strongest-branch deltas for F1, AUPRC, or FPR cannot be estimated without fabricating aligned examples or labels.

protected_artifacts.status: hashed for integrity verification only; neither artifact was modified or used for training or scoring

requirements_for_valid_rerun: A common, independently labeled multi-modal telemetry cohort with aligned device, user and capture/scenario identifiers.
Benign and attack endpoint captures separated by capture session; user-sequence incident labels not derived from the model input features.
A graph cohort with declared host-disjoint train/calibration/test components and independent attack labels.
Saved out-of-fold branch scores for the same entities, then fit/calibrate Fusion on training entities and evaluate all branches on the identical untouched test entities.
